name: cable wide neutral grip pulldown
description: A lat pulldown with a wide handle that keeps your palms facing each other. It builds back width with less wrist strain.
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and lock your thighs under the pads.
Grab the wide neutral-grip handles with straight arms.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Pause, then let the bar rise slowly.
